text: Welcome. Start with W-0 in pc-kickoff.md; rules in two-machine.md (Ruling 106). Push only win/* with a PR; post pr-ready here.

Request PC ownership of new docs/design/windows-native-store.md for the W-2 design-only PR. It will cite Ruling 121, freeze a new Windows helper path, exclude cfd_store.c, and seek Fable/Data approval with Security/Test vetoes before B2. No source implementation begins on this handoff.

PR #3 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS; docs/reviews/pr-3.md). Approved: the PC owns the new docs/design/windows-native-store.md for the W-2 design-only PR, as requested (cites Ruling 121, new Windows helper path, cfd_store.c excluded). Fable/Data review on the Mac before B2 starts.

Request Mac capture/control for class: external command invoked before owned destination parent exists. Sweep found both WSL import and tutorial extraction. Proposed prevention: assert/create the exact owned parent before the external command and include a negative-path gate. PC did not edit the shared defect register.

PR #4 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS as a blocked checkpoint; docs/reviews/pr-4.md). W-3 re-entry authorised by Ruling 133 as a fresh 60-min track with its own cap: mkdir -p /root/CFDWorkbench/fixture-cache; sha256sum the tutorial .deb (expect 4c87494c...); dpkg-deb -x; freeze cases/win-smoke-cavity.yaml with LF inputs and blob-equal hashes BEFORE launch; cavity to t=0.5 under M1, 60 s timeout, compare Courant mean with 0.222158; update only observed Inferred rows of guided-solver-setup.md. In the same PR: rewrite SU2 inputs with LF and make yaml/manifest hashes equal the committed bytes. Do not edit the design's route steps; the Mac records the route-parent defect. W-4 waits for the completed W-3 review.

The Mac fixed the W-1 shared defects (merged on main): python resolver in run-tests.sh/join-ring.sh (tools/py-resolve.sh), in-window NativeMenuBar plus KeyBindings off macOS (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+S, all menu shortcuts), thrown save failures shown in the status strip, live point automation names. Please re-run the W-1 walk per docs/proof/wfx/pc-reverify.md (incl. Alt/F10 menu access and the single-fire table) and the full Windows ring with every failing test named, as a W-1b PR. W-2 B1 canonical Windows store design; tested SHA 94c0b164 matches receipt; Astra PASS; docs gate PASS; stderr captured; audit al-01M4BTPB79GZ7ZCR9JC2B4S5KG. Please rule D-B1-DUR, exact B2 leases and independent Data/Security/Test vetoes. B2 locked.

PR #5 merged (Fable APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS; data-persistence CLEAR WITH CONDITIONS, veto cleared for the design only; docs/reviews/pr-5.md). Operator ruled 135: Windows Save SHIPS with FlushFileBuffers + atomic rename via FileRenameInfoEx(REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX_SEMANTICS) (no dir flush exists; label the durability level); default save folder local outside OneDrive; OneDrive folders refused with a plain message (draft it as proposed copy). B2 conditions in pr-5.md (held-reader overwrite test red/green on NTFS, POSIX disposition, NFC/NFD, case-sensitive dirs, crash recovery, >260-char path, citations, leases with handoffs for the 3 shared files, compiler/SDK decision for the csproj).

check-docs now runs case validation (validate-cases.py --self-test and the full set). It needs uv on PATH (it re-runs under uv run --with jsonschema --with pyyaml) or jsonschema+pyyaml in your Python; otherwise it fails by name. The spike03-s6-w4.yaml schema defect is fixed on main (geometry.source.outcome produced|not-produced). New tools: tools/verify-push.sh (a push is done only when the remote ref equals the local SHA) and tools/py-resolve.sh.

W-1b/WFX failure-evidence checkpoint ready. Tested source defbe0a931e703068a4c06278a413c0cf6d7b6bc; evidence commit a7a8e1e6; Owner PASS; docs PASS. Native name/events, Undo/Redo restoration, Analysis and visible Save refusals verified. Ring exit 1 with 39 named failures, Desktop exit 70/no frame, and 10 cost failures. Receipt docs/proof/win-smoke-reverify/receipt.md.

Please grant affirmative B2 handoffs for tests/CfdWorkbench.Core.Tests/ProjectStoreTests.cs, tools/verify-application-core.py, and docs/proof/application-core.md, and confirm the existing four Persistence leases from windows-native-store.md section 6. Compiler proposal: MSVC Hostx64/x64 cl.exe file version 19.44.35228.0 from VS 2022 Community toolset 14.44.35207 with Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0; build the Windows-only cfd_store_windows.c via CfdWorkbench.Persistence.csproj while leaving the macOS target and native/cfd_store.c unchanged. Reply with approval or narrowed paths/compiler route before B2 dispatch.

PR #6 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS; docs/reviews/pr-6.md). Ruling 137: you may edit ONLY the platform gates of ProjectStoreTests.cs (:12, :414), Windows cases in a new WindowsProjectStoreTests.cs; write tools/verify-windows-store.py (lease granted) and docs/proof/win-store-implementation/; do not edit verify-application-core.py or application-core.md. B2 may start. The Mac takes: numeric determinism (catalog/golden), JSON NewLine, symlink tests, Desktop crash frame, F10/Escape/undo status, Windows cost budgets.

W-3 Ruling 133 checkpoint ready. Numerical evidence/ring-tested SHA 614f9cce009b0bc7cfaee55faec1bcc679e8782c; evidence head 9fa2963f; Owner PASS; docs PASS. OpenFOAM cavity t=0.5/Courant mean 0.222158 and LF SU2 CD 2.885552317 pass. Required ring ran once: exit 1, 60.992 s, 39 named failures, Desktop exit 70/no frame, 10 cost failures. W-4/W-5 and GPU remain held. Receipt docs/proof/win-routes/receipt.md.

PR #7 merged (APPROVE; docs/reviews/pr-7.md). W-3 is complete and W-4 may start: GPU one measurement-only attempt inside W-4a's 60 min that feeds nothing; W-4a records the measured cross-OS Courant/Cl/Cd difference; L3 per Ruling 79 (no 10 h cap, nice, <= cores-2, note at start, done/blocked at end, then gci.py); W-5 per Ruling 102 step 1 first, beside L3 only if cores allow. Also merging now: WFX2 (crash detail in the test harness, JSON NewLine pinned, junction-based symlink tests, catalog refusal reason in Exception.Data, F10/Escape menu keys, Undo/Redo status, Imperial spanwise table) - re-verify per docs/proof/wfx2/pc-reverify.md with your next ring.

Ruling 139 is on main: C-5 now takes the load gate; on a Git Bash host (/proc/loadavg, uname MINGW/MSYS/CYGWIN) every cost rule and TEST-BUDGET prints COST-MISS host <name> and exits 0 until docs/proof/ring-<host>/baseline.csv holds 3 quiet runs (first line gate=<n>, then <run>,<end load>,<wall ms> rows). Recording that baseline is yours when convenient; the ms limits are not re-based, and a quiet over-limit reading is a finding for the operator.

Before W-4 runs any cases/tools/make-*.py generator on Windows: merge main (31d45cb8 or later). Every text-mode write in those generators now pins newline LF (WINDOWS-TEXT-MODE-HASH), so cfdw-manifest.json hashes equal the committed LF bytes. tools/check-text-mode-hash.py in check-docs guards it. A run from an older checkout writes CRLF and its manifest matches no committed input.

Ruling 145 (Fable owner, APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS) answers PR #8. Before merge: redact the machine SID in docs/proof/win-store-implementation/red-native.stdout.txt to S-1-5-21-<machine>-<RID> and C:\Users\<name> paths to %USERPROFILE% in every new proof file, with a one-line redaction note; push, and I merge PR #8 as the preserved checkpoint. Then a fresh B2 track is approved (new 2-cycle budget): red-first ShareRead|ShareDelete overwrite and ShareRead-only deterministic refusal as two new cases (keep the failing probe), the NULL-root class 22 + rooted class 3 probe, Win32 32 mapped to a stable product code in design section 4, ProjectStore fail-closed. NtSetInformationFile class 65 is affirmed with no fallback. ShellHost/CLI reader share flags, picker default path, OneDrive placement and copy stay Mac-owned.
